chapters.title: No other gospel
chapters.summary: Paul is astonished that the Galatians are turning to a different gospel. He received his message by revelation from Jesus Christ, not from people.

chapters.title: Crucified with Christ
chapters.summary: The Jerusalem leaders accepted Paul's gospel, and he opposed Peter at Antioch. A person is justified by faith in Christ, not works of the law. I am crucified with Christ.

chapters.title: All one in Christ
chapters.summary: The Galatians received the Spirit by faith. The law was a guardian until Christ. There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ.

chapters.title: Children, not slaves
chapters.summary: In the fullness of time God sent His Son so that we might be adopted and cry, Abba, Father. Paul pleads with them not to return to slavery.

chapters.title: The fruit of the Spirit
chapters.summary: Stand fast in the freedom Christ gives. Walk by the Spirit. The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.

chapters.title: Bear one another's burdens
chapters.summary: Restore those who fall, and bear one another's burdens. Whatever you sow you will reap; do not grow weary in doing good. Paul boasts only in the cross.
